name: Pulsar OS Focus Reporter
description: Reports the focused window (PID + app) to $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/pulsaros-focused.json so pulsaros-optimizer can boost the foreground app and learn workflow habits. GNOME >= 45 disabled org.gnome.Shell.Eval, and a root system service has no session bus, so this extension is the only reliable focus channel on Wayland.
